chapters.reason: The paper focuses on continuous-valued tokens (CoT2) to track multiple discrete traces in parallel, directly aligning with the use of continuous latent representations to promote diverse parallel reasoning trajectories.

The authors introduce a novel supervision strategy that matches language model outputs to empirical token distributions of target traces, ensuring semantic fidelity between continuous latent outputs and explicit reasoning targets.
The approach steers reasoning by manipulating individual tokens through a continuous-valued representation (CoT2) rather than relying on standard discrete text token generation.
